subtitle: Out Manila · Chang An Airlines
overview: A short no-shopping charter-flight tour: land in Yichang, drive to Zhangjiajie for Baofeng Lake, Tianmen Mountain, the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park) and the Grand Canyon glass bridge, then return to Yichang for a Yangtze River Three Gorges Tribe cruise before flying home. Hotels are Ramada or similar.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 28–31 2026 to Dec 28–31 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Baofeng Lake: A scenic mountain lake near Zhangjiajie, explored by boat cruise (included).
placeDesc.72 Wander Buildings: A tall, unusual tower complex in Zhangjiajie; the ticket is included in this tour.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie with a long cable car, a glass skywalk and the natural arch of Tianmen Cave.
placeDesc.Tianmen Cave: A huge natural arch in Tianmen Mountain, reached by steps or the mountain scenic route.
placeDesc.Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National: A famous park of tall sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains in the movie Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to go up and down in the park.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge between two cliffs inside the scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The sandstone pillar in the park that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in Avatar.
placeDesc.West Sea Clouds: A scenic viewpoint in the Zhangjiajie area known for sea-of-clouds views among the peaks.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon glass bridge: A glass bridge over a deep canyon in the Zhangjiajie region.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Tribe Scenic Area: A scenic area on the Yangtze River near Yichang with Tujia cultural features; a cruise is included.
placeDesc.Qu Yuan’s hometown: The birthplace area of the ancient poet Qu Yuan, in the Yichang region.
placeDesc.San You Cave: A scenic cave and gorge site near Yichang on the Yangtze River.
